snippet.title: Jump King Quest - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
1.0 Phantom Update is now available for download on Steam!

Jump King Quest is the unhinged evolution of the climbing-game genre, a precision platformer with soulslike fighting game fusion combat, RPG mechanics and dynamic multiplayer!

NOTE: We HIGHLY RECOMMEND starting a new character! Old saves are likely to have issues with NPCs and more, and will miss the added content.

A post with all the details is in the works and will be up in a short while.

Get it:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2317640/JUMP_KING_QUEST/
